_about: Hand-checked facts for the knowledge-graph extraction eval. Every quote must appear word for word in the PDF (checked by tests/test_kg.py). amount_rs is the charge in rupees (0 = free); percent is used instead for percentage penalties. answer_pattern is a regex used to detect the charge in a free-text answer when scoring the graph-vs-RAG questions. Charges marked added_after_review were missing from the first version of this file; the model extracted them, and a check against the PDF showed they are real facts.
